nuggets.text: The Wolfpack have not lost to an FCS team since 1987, when East Tennessee State pulled it off.
The Wolfpack's 2026 opener at Virginia was first scheduled for Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, before moving to Charlottesville.
The Wolfpack last faced Richmond in 2013 and won 23-21 on Niklas Sade's 48-yard field goal with 33 seconds left.
Wolfpack coach Dave Doeren also led NC State the last time it played Richmond, in 2013, his second game in Raleigh.
The Wolfpack and Richmond were once conference colleagues in two different leagues.
Wolfpack coach Dave Doeren played tight end at Drake and was on Montana's 2001 national championship staff.
Wolfpack QB CJ Bailey threw for 9,005 yards and 116 touchdowns at Chaminade-Madonna Prep in Hollywood, Florida.
The Wolfpack beat Notre Dame 10-3 in 2016 in driving rain in the middle of Hurricane Matthew.
The Wolfpack added a live mascot in 2010: Tuffy, a purebred Tamaskan dog with a wolf-like look.
The Wolfpack's Carter-Finley Stadium, capacity 56,919, is the largest college football stadium in North Carolina.
